rationale: For a delivery driver app, clarity, high contrast, and large touch targets are paramount. The environment is outdoors, moving, and time-sensitive. A crisp white/slate background with a vibrant primary blue ensures critical information (like addresses and PINs) pops instantly.

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex flex-col relative pb-24

Button.primary: w-full h-14 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold text-lg rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors active:scale-[0.98]
Button.secondary: w-full h-14 bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-bold text-lg rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50 active:scale-[0.98]
Button.disabled: w-full h-14 bg-slate-200 text-slate-400 font-bold text-lg rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center cursor-not-allowed
Button.sticky_container: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-5 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-slate-200 z-50 max-w-md mx-auto pb-8

Card.base: bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-3 relative overflow-hidden

Input.pin: w-full h-16 bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-center text-2xl font-bold tracking-[0.2em] focus:border-blue-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-slate-300
Input.camera_upload: w-full h-32 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-slate-500 cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 hover:border-blue-400 transition-colors

TopNav.base: w-full h-16 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between px-5 sticky top-0 z-40

icons.usage: Use bold or duotone weights for clarity. Sizes: 24px for standard, 32px for empty states/hero.

elements: Subtitle: 'Enter your 4-digit PIN to access orders'
Top Nav: Driver Name (Test Driver), Online Status Indicator
Order Card: Order #, Address (prominent), Item count, Total price
Action: 'Accept Order' button inside card OR sticky at bottom if single selected

Screen3_Shopping.layout: List view with sticky bottom action.
elements: Checklist Items: Custom large hit-area checkboxes. When checked -> strikethrough text and dim opacity.
Sticky Bottom Bar: 'Start Delivery' button (disabled until all items = checked)

Screen4_Delivery.layout: Vertical stack with clear separation of steps.
elements: Address Block: Large text, map icon
Verification Step: Customer PIN input field (Driver asks customer)
Proof Step: Camera upload area (HTML input capture='environment')

rules: All buttons, inputs, and list items MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Use kebab-case for data-testid values (e.g., data-testid='accept-order-button').
Do not use appearance-based test IDs.

animations.transitions: Use Tailwind default transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for buttons and inputs.
animations.lists: Staggered fade-in for list items if using framer-motion, otherwise simple CSS appear.
animations.interactions: active:scale-[0.98] on all major touch targets to provide physical feedback.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app is built mobile-first. Max width should be restricted to mobile dimensions (e.g. max-w-md mx-auto) on desktop screens.
Use Phosphor icons for all iconography.
The PIN login should restrict to exactly 4 digits. Use a number-pad keyboard type (input type='tel' or inputMode='numeric').
For the camera upload, use <input type='file' accept='image/*' capture='environment' /> to trigger the native camera on mobile.
Supabase Realtime should be implemented carefully to update the 'Available Orders' list instantly.
All primary action buttons MUST be fixed to the bottom (sticky) so the driver doesn't have to scroll to find them while walking.
